As predicted, the "NOT(all patterns seen)" case is slow: 2.23s for 15552 states (the distance seed is weak there). Let me find the max product under 20000 for this family and measure the worst case.

Let me tune to get close to 20000 with the `not(and(contains...))` structure.

cd /workspace/tmp/dev && timeout 600 python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, time, random, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def psize(obj, cap=20005):
    m.MAX_TUPLES = cap
    services = obj["services"]
    si = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(services)}
    atoms = m.collect_atoms(obj["rules"])
    mons = [m.build_monitor(op, p, si, len(services))[0] for op, p in atoms]
    res = m.build_product(mons, len(services))
    return (len(res[0]) if res else None)

rng = random.Random(123)
best = (0, None)
t0 = time.time()
while time.time() - t0 < 120:
    nsvc = rng.randint(10, 24)
    natoms = rng.randint(6, 10)
    pats = [[rng.choice(["t%02d" % i for i in range(nsvc)]) for _ in range(rng.randint(6, 16))] for _ in range(natoms)]
    rules = [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": "and",
              "args": [{"op": "contains", "path": p} for p in pats]}}}]
    obj = {"services": ["t%02d" % i for i in range(nsvc)], "rules": rules, "queries": []}
    ps = psize(obj)
    if ps and ps > best[0]:
        best = (ps, obj); print("best", ps, flush=True)
ps, obj = best
obj["queries"] = [["t%02d" % i for i in range(len(obj["services"]))]]
json.dump(obj, open("hard_case3.json", "w"))
t0 = time.time(); res = m.compile_request(obj); el = time.time()-t0
out = json.loads(res)
print("product=%d minimal=%d %.2fs" % (ps, len(out["dfa"]["accept"]), el))
EOF
